items.evidence: Log lines 2-193 show 18 uL aspirated from reservoir A1 and dispensed into each of the 96 PCR wells, with a single tip.
Log shows 1 uL from each colony_plate well into the matching pcr_plate well (lines 196-1153) and 1 uL from each primer_plate well into the matching well (1156-1537), all with the p20, giving 20 uL.
Each colony and each primer transfer has its own pick up tip and drop tip. The single master-mix tip only touched the reservoir and dispensed into empty wells.
The final protocol.comment records sealing and the full program: 98C 30 s; 30 cycles of 98C 10 s, 60C 30 s, 72C 30 s; 72C 2 min; 4C hold.
The steps follow the task order, including mixing 3x after the colony dispense. The comment is accurate and no steps are invented. Master-mix dispenses at top(-2) with blow-out are a harmless choice.

judge.summary: The protocol matches the log: 18 uL master mix into all 96 wells, then 1 uL colony with a 3x mix and 1 uL primer per well, each with a fresh tip. The thermocycling comment is present and accurate, so all items pass.
